svg.title: O2C Finance Workspace Design
svg.desc: Five editable vector screen specifications: desktop overview, receivables, approval review, CSV import review, and mobile overview. All financial values are unavailable placeholders; no business records are represented.
svg.text: A clear workspace. Every decision accountable.
UI specification · Empty and unprovisioned states · No synthetic balances, users or approvals

g.text: A clear view of your receivables and cash position.

Lists show up to 50 records. Totals cover the full legal entity.
Governed source balances · Exact decimal amounts · No automatic revenue recognition
Review the exact proposal and its financial impact before posting.
Select a preserved proposal in the approval inbox.
Compare the current records with captured evidence.
A maker cannot approve their own proposal. Posting remains a separate confirmed action.

svg.text: Pearl surfaces · Purple navigation and actions · Teal confirmation · Text accompanies every status
